claims.rationale: Acarbose label states it has been shown to change digoxin bioavailability, which may require digoxin dose adjustment.
French label says acarbose can in some cases interfere with digoxin bioavailability requiring dose adaptation; translation is faithful.
Crossover study in healthy men found digoxin AUC and Cmax significantly lower and tmax higher with acarbose versus digoxin alone.
Claim presents it as a single case report and accurately states digoxin levels rose to therapeutic range after acarbose was stopped.
